scripts.gitbook:build: npm run gitbook:summary && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" honkit build
scripts.gitbook:serve: npm run gitbook:summary && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" honkit serve
scripts.gitbook:stop: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000,35729 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
scripts.pdf:build: python scripts/compile_docs.py && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" node scripts/generate_pdf.js
